tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and window background. A lichen-grey neutral with a slight green bias; never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: the script editor, cards, menus.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, input borders, dividers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and plume-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and status lines on ground or surface (5.8:1 light, 6.6:1 dark at worst).

tokens.name: plume
tokens.usage: The brand hue: the feather, the primary action (Render), links, focus ring. As text on ground or surface (5.2:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: plume-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind plume elements: selected voice row, active chip. plume and ink both read on it.

tokens.name: on-plume
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a plume fill. Dark text in the dark theme because plume lightens there — never hard-code white.

tokens.name: fern
tokens.usage: Deep eucalyptus. The app-icon tile and dark brand panels. Fill only; text on it is ground (light) or ink (dark).

tokens.name: lyre
tokens.usage: Tail-band gold: the waveform barbs of the mark on fern or dark grounds, small highlights. Fill only, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: speaker
tokens.usage: Editor: a recognised speaker name (Alice:) in the script, bold. From lyrebird.py.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Editor: sound tag text when the selected model supports tags. From lyrebird.py.

tokens.name: tag-bg
tokens.usage: Editor: background behind a supported sound tag.

tokens.name: tag-off
tokens.usage: Editor: sound tag text when the selected model ignores tags.

tokens.name: tag-off-bg
tokens.usage: Editor: background behind an ignored sound tag.

tokens.name: tag-bad
tokens.usage: Editor: an unknown tag, underlined as well as coloured so it never relies on hue alone.

families.app: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines on the site and release banners. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything runs locally on your PC.
styles.usage: Running text in docs and the site.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: About 3 GB with an NVIDIA GPU.

styles.name: script
styles.sample: Alice: Did you hear the news? [laugh]
styles.usage: Dialogue scripts, sound tags and code in docs.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Audio specs, seeds, file names, status readouts.

styles.name: app-ui
styles.usage: The desktop app's own controls (Tk, Segoe UI 10pt). Brand faces stay out of the app window.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding-block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding-inline, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, default gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page sections on the site.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Sound-tag chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile (14 of 64 units) and large brand panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Model badges (Standard / Turbo / Multilingual).

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels and menus only. Everything else separates by line, not shadow.
